transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: I know this isn’t easy for any of us. Maybe we can just hear from the people who feel ready to take the lead? Let’s get clear about who’s comfortable stepping up.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Could we just clarify who’s considering leading? I can help with the technical write-up or data, but I don’t feel ready to lead the pitch myself.

transcript.name: Rafael Carvalho
transcript.text: Alright, I’ll speak up. I’m willing to lead the pitch if that’s where the group lands, but what matters more is that we put forward our strongest case—together. Anyone else seriously thinking about leading? Or do you want me to take it? Either way, I want to hear what’s on your mind before we decide.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: If Rafael’s offering, I think that makes sense. Unless someone else wants to step in? I’m comfortable supporting, but I don’t want to lead this time.

transcript.name: Erik Lundström
transcript.text: I’m fine with Rafael taking the lead if that’s where we land, but just so we’re clear—does anyone have concerns or want to talk it through more? I’d rather we say it now than regret it later.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: I’m okay with Rafael taking the lead if that’s where we’re landing. Just want to make sure everyone’s comfortable with it—if anyone has doubts or wants to talk through the pitch approach, now’s the time. Also, Rafael, would you want me to coordinate the design section or is someone else taking that?

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: I’m good with Rafael leading. Just want to be clear who’s handling what so we don’t get tripped up like we did with the last pitch.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Alright, I’m not waiting for more polite hesitations. If no one objects, I’ll take the lead and drive the pitch myself. Rafael, you want it? Say so. Otherwise, let’s stop wasting time. We need one name and a clear plan, right now.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: I think either Rafael or Natasha could lead. For me, the main thing is just making sure we know who's handling what and actually get started on the pitch. Maybe Rafael and Natasha can just decide between themselves? I’m happy to take on any backend technical write-up, wherever it’s needed.

transcript.name: Wei Zhou
transcript.text: Maybe just a quick check—do we know who’ll cover compliance in the pitch? Also, Rafael, Natasha, are you both okay with one person leading and the other supporting? Just want to be clear before we move.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: Has anyone already picked up compliance for the pitch? If not, I can help with that section along with the backend details.

transcript.name: Rafael Carvalho
transcript.text: Alright, let’s make this official: I’ll lead the pitch. Natasha, if you want to drive a section, let’s talk right after. Élise, would love you on design. Amitesh and Wei—sounds like you’re set for compliance and backend. If anyone’s got doubts or sees a gap, say it now. I want us all feeling good about the plan before we start building it out.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: If anyone’s still unsure or has a concern, this is a good time to bring it up. I just want to be sure we’re all on board before we get started.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: If anyone's got a nagging concern, probably best to put it out there. Rather catch problems early than after we start building this thing.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: Fine. Rafael, you’ve got the lead—don’t waffle. I’ll drive the financials and competitive analysis. Anyone unclear about their job, say it now, not later. I want sharp execution this time, no grey areas.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Just to confirm—am I handling the technical documentation for the pitch? If someone else already started, let me know. I can pick it up or support wherever it’s needed.

transcript.name: Lilian Njoroge
transcript.text: Just checking—has anyone picked up the reporting and data summary piece for the pitch? If not, I can help with that, but I don’t want to duplicate work.

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Okay, so just to double-check—if anyone’s not clear on their bit, please just say so now. Rafael, just let me know if you want anything specific from design, or if you want a first draft by a certain date.

transcript.name: Lucía Mendoza
transcript.text: Before we wrap, does everyone know who to check with if something comes up? Just want to be sure no one’s left guessing.

transcript.name: Rafael Carvalho
transcript.text: Alright, quick check—if anything’s still unclear or you get stuck, come straight to me. Don’t let it stew. Let’s make sure nobody’s left spinning alone. We’re in this together, so shout if you hit a wall, okay?

transcript.name: Élise Moreau
transcript.text: Alright, just so we’re all clear—I’m around if anyone needs to bounce ideas on design, or if you get stuck. Don’t hesitate to flag anything, even if it feels small. Better now than in crunch time.

transcript.name: Amitesh Iyer
transcript.text: All clear on my side. If anything pops up while I’m working through backend or compliance, I’ll reach out.

transcript.name: Natasha Volkov
transcript.text: If anyone gets confused or stuck, don’t dance around it—say so immediately. No excuses, no hiding. We cannot afford hand-holding or last-minute surprises. Speak up straight away, or own it if you drop the ball.

transcript.name: Todd Ramsey
transcript.text: Alright, I’m set on my end. If anything shifts or you need backup, just let me know. Otherwise, I’ll keep moving on my sections.

transcript.name: Trang Nguyen
transcript.text: Lilian, just to be sure—do you want to split the data summary, or should I stay focused on the technical docs? I can help with numbers if you need backup.
